stories.title: The NFL Rookie Progress Report: How all 257 draft picks are faring with their new teams
stories.summary: When will Fernando Mendoza start? Should we expect big things for Sonny Styles, Ja'Kobi Lane and Cashius Howell? We checked in on all 32 NFL teams' rookie classes.

stories.title: Judge: SEC can't punish teams that play ex-pros
stories.summary: A temporary restraining order prohibits the SEC from enforcing a new rule that threatens stiff penalties for any team that uses a player who previously signed a contract to play in the NFL, NBA or WNBA.

stories.title: Florida's Golden gets another extension and raise
stories.summary: Todd Golden's third raise in as many years with the Florida Gators will make him the second-highest-paid basketball coach in the Southeastern Conference.

stories.title: Sources: MLB suspends prospect in fake-age plot
stories.summary: Major League Baseball has suspended a once-prized Dominican prospect after uncovering an age-fraud plot that included a fictitious death, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Big Ten to have 4 player status reports a week
stories.summary: The Big Ten will now require teams to submit four player availability reports per week for games matching conference opponents. Since 2023, Big Ten teams have been reporting once a week.
